title: Khaa'iniintii la doortay
intro: Taariikhda oo dhan, rasuullo rabbaani ah ayaa ku dhex socday aadanaha, qaar ka mid ah kuwa ugu dhowna way garan waayeen iftiinka. Qisadani waxay ku wareegsan tahay laba nafood oo u dhowaanshaha nebinimada ay noqotay imtixaankooda, dhaxalkooduna uu yahay cashar aan waqti lahayn.
clues: Waxaan ku noolayn waqtiyadii nebiyada waaweyn, haddana indhaheenna waxay ku xirnaayeen runta ay keeneen.
Guryaheenna waxaa ka buuxay waxyi rabbaani ah, laakiin qalbiyadeennu way adkaayeen.
Waxaan guursannay rag loo doortay inay dadkooda u digaan.
Markii ciqaabtu timid, doonnidii kuma aanan dhuuman mana aanan ka cararin roobkii gubayay, sababtoo ah digniinaha waan ku jeesjeesanay.
Waxaa Qur'aanka lagu xusay tusaale ahaan kuwa gaaloobay, taasoo muujinaysa in xitaa xiriirka dhow ee lala leeyahay nebi uusan badbaadinayn.
Annagu waxaan nahay xaasaskii Nuux iyo Luud, kuwaas oo khiyaameeyay sidaas darteedna la xukumay.

trial.label: Maxkamadeyntoodu maxay ahayd?
options: Waxay guursadeen nebiyo laakiin way gaaloobeen
Waxay ahaayeen madhalays waxayna eedeeyeen nebiyada
Waxay ahaayeen kuwo hodan ah oo isla weyn
Waxaa Ibliis ku qasbay inay guryahooda ka baxaan.
Waxay caabudi jireen weyshii dahabka ahayd
trial.answer: Waxay guursadeen nebiyo laakiin way gaaloobeen

outcome.label: Maxay ahaayeen dhammaadkoodii?
options: Waxay la halaageen gaalada iyagoo la jira
Way toobad keeneen oo way badbaadeen
Waxaa loo beddelay daanyeero iyo doofaarro
outcome.answer: Waxay la halaageen gaalada iyagoo la jira

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
